title: EIF quality-per-token benchmark result record
description: One record = one (task, mode, run) execution. The harness emits one of these per attempt, success or failure - a failed run is still a valid record (completion_success: false), never omitted. See docs/benchmarks/README.md and the private PACKET-EIF-QUALITY-PER-TOKEN-BENCHMARK for the corpus, modes, and methodology this schema serves. Validated with jsonschema's Draft202012Validator, same convention as every other EIF schema.

task_id.description: References a task in the corpus (see the private planning packet's corpus table).

mode.description: A: no EIF, no Graphify, no RTK. B: EIF, no Graphify, no RTK. C: EIF + Graphify, no RTK. D: EIF + Graphify + RTK.

run_index.description: 0-based repeat index for this exact (task_id, mode) pair - repeated runs are required by methodology, not optional.

randomized_order_seed.description: Seed used to randomize mode order for this run batch, so mode order itself is not a confound. null only for a single manual/debug run, never for a real batch.

settings.description: Free-form: temperature, max_tokens, thinking/reasoning effort, etc. - whatever this run's harness actually configured, so a later reader can tell if two records are truly comparable.

target_ref.description: For synthetic_fixture: the fixture's own id/path in the corpus. For public_repository: 'owner/name'.

frozen_commit_sha.description: Required for public_repository (reproducibility); a synthetic fixture may instead pin a fixture-bundle digest in provenance.

provenance.description: How this exact input state was materialized for this run - fixture digest, clone method, applied patches, etc.

completion_success.description: Did the run reach a terminal state the harness recognizes as 'done', regardless of whether the result was CORRECT - see tests_passed for correctness.

factual_errors.description: Count of claims made during the run that were checked and found false.

review_findings.description: Count of code-review-style findings against the produced change.

rework_loops.description: Count of times the run had to backtrack/redo prior work within the same attempt.

raw_reruns.description: Count of times this exact (task_id, mode, run_index) had to be discarded and restarted from scratch due to harness/environment failure (not counted as a normal run_index).

setup_cost_seconds.description: One-time cost to prepare the environment for this mode (installing EIF/Graphify/RTK), amortized or recorded per run per methodology.

index_or_graph_refresh_cost_seconds.description: Cost to (re)build the knowledge index (mode B+) or the structural graph (mode C+) for this input state - null for mode A.

maintenance_overhead_notes.description: Free text: anything about keeping the mode's tooling current/working that a raw number doesn't capture.

raw_log_ref.description: Pointer (path or URL) to the full raw transcript/log for this run - the record itself stays a compact summary, never the full transcript inline.
